scope: Portable train/validation-only extraction; not the complete historical preparation program.

weather.selection: train_end=int(N*0.7); val_end=train_end+int(N*0.1); preserve full-lattice index times

ushcn.selection: String-sort source IDs, apply numpy.random.default_rng(seed).permutation, retain first int(N*0.6) then next int(N*0.2). Preserve this shuffled order for scaler fitting and outputs.
ushcn.source_note: Already-processed five-channel benchmark derivative; not untouched NOAA observations and not rebuilt from its CSV here. Physical station/calendar mappings remain unresolved.

transform: Finite observed training entries only; float64 pooled mean and population standard deviation; scales at or below float64 epsilon set to one; float32 transform, missing entries zero, no clipping.
serialization_caveat: Tensor slices are cloned to prevent retained backing storage. Regenerated file bytes and hashes can differ with container representation, NumPy/PyTorch versions and serialization. No bit-identical or real-data rerun verification is claimed.
